lines.t: You're reaching for light, in the fading light
Holding tight to what can't survive the night
Golden dreams made of dust and pride
While the truth keeps calling from the other side
You walk the wide road under neon skies
But your heart knows every glitter dies
Those who cling to the world will lose their way
Dead men's bones in a wasteland grave
All the treasures and towers fade from sight
Compared to the gift of eternal life
He said there's nothing, nothing apart from Him
The way, the truth, the light within
What is gold when your soul feels torn?
What are kings when the crown feels worn?
The hands that build will crumble and burn
The story they write comes to dust in the end
You can chase the glow till the stars go dim
But you'll find no peace apart from Him
Those who cling to the world will lose their way
Dead man's bones in a wasteland grave
All the works of man will fade like night
Only his love remains in life
He said there's nothing, nothing apart from Him
The way, the truth, the life within
You ask, what's their worth, what do they mean
When the mirror shows what might have been
Let the old fade, let the heart be still
Only love of the Lord can fill
Those who cling to the world will lose
But the humble soul will be lifted down
All else passes, but His call is true
Ooh, He is life, and He waits for you
There's nothing, nothing apart from Him
The way, the truth, the light within
Let go, let go of the passing wind
For there's nothing apart
Nothing apart from you
Thank you.
